Name: Into the Game (Save Loaded Notifier)
Author: DecidedlyHuman
Description:
Code:
[img]https://img.shields.io/github/license/DecidedlyHuman/StardewValleyMods[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029182.png[/img]
This super simple mod will make a noise (the train whistle by default, but you can specify your own game sound in the config) when your save has fully loaded, so that you never miss it, and don't have to check every few seconds.

It also pops up a little window with a welcome message in-game when your save has loaded so that you don't accidentally waste half of the day if you're AFK when it happens.


[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763028878.png[/img][/b]
1.2.0 — Now you can specify the sound cue that's played in the config! See the list of sound cues on the Stardew Valley wiki: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#Track_list]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#Track_list[/url]
1.0.0 — The mod exists!


[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1772985205.png[/img][/b]
If you want to contribute translations, first of all, thank you! However you want to get the translations to me is fine, whether it be via a PR on GitHub, or just sending me a DM here, pinging me on the Stardew Valley Discord, whatever is best for you.
